items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Spencer Williams writing all them things, Bourbon Street, recognized songwriter.

ctx.x: Paul went to New York with Luis Russell after King Oliver’s band broke up. Red Allen went on a boat with Fate Marable. Made two trips, two or three trips. Musicians leaving town and going all the time. You heard . . . you never saw Jelly Roll [Morton], but you heard of him. You never see Clarence [Williams], but you heard of him. All people that were doing good, they show you examples. They would tell you. Spencer Williams writing all them things, Bourbon Street, recognized songwriter. Mahogany Hall Stomp and it…
Is that why a lot of musicians left New Orleans, because they could make more money and conditions were a little bit better away?
